image_description: A high-angle, eye-level shot of an ornate stone altar in a church sanctuary. The altar features a white marble top slab draped with a white cloth on the right side, supported by a carved golden-brown stone base with intricate relief carvings and blue inlays. Behind the altar is a highly detailed wooden reredos with Gothic-style tracery and three stained-glass windows. A bronze tabernacle sits on the center of the altar. Two tall candlesticks flank the central object. The floor has a geometric patterned tile design.
